dataset.title: Online Retail

dataset.changes: Positive-purchase cleaning, aggregation, preprocessing and explicitly simulated monetary multipliers. Provider lines not redistributed.

methods.title: RobustScaler
methods.inspected: Training medians and25th–75th percentile feature scaling; no clipping or robust KMeans objective

methods.title: StandardScaler
methods.inspected: Training means and population standard deviations, reuse transform, sensitivity to outliers

methods.title: KMeans
methods.inspected: Explicit n_init10, fixed random_state13, Lloyd squared-distance objective and nearest-center predictions

methods.title: Adjusted Rand index
methods.inspected: Chance-adjusted partition agreement, invariant to label permutation; not customer-type accuracy

source_status: Official provider and versioned method documentation. Established methods, no recent-paper or novel-algorithm claim.

code_and_artwork.origin: Original authored analysis and matplotlib figure; shared cleaning/oracle functions from original unpublished5November study

public_scope: Code, hashes and aggregate actual outputs only. No provider rows/IDs/private predictions/fitted parameters or private LinkedIn analytics.
